title: Integral-closure product model of a Cartier torsor normalization over the actual DVR stalk
statement: Under the Cartier complement, finite etale pulled-back finite G-torsor, locally Noetherian base, finite normalization, integral centre with generic point eta, and domain DVR stalk hypotheses of lem-sbc-cartier-generic-stalk-galois-model-core, put R = O_(N,j(eta)) and K = Frac R. There exist finitely many fields E_i with K-algebra structures, subgroups T_i of G and actions of T_i on E_i making IsGaloisGroup T_i K E_i hold. Equip E_i with the composite R-algebra structure. Every concrete ring integralClosure R E_i is module finite over R. The pullback of the entire normalization along Spec R -> N is isomorphic over Spec R to the coproduct of Spec(integralClosure R E_i); the structural maps are precisely Spec of the canonical R-algebra maps. This assertion has no selected point, prime, residue comparison, or action on integral closures or their canonical fraction fields.

source.place: Tags 0307, 03SF and 03QR; steps 1 and 2 of lem-sbc-cartier-generic-stalk-galois-model-core. Tag 09EB is background arithmetic, not the geometric model theorem.

proof.text: Use cartier_stalk_punctured_complement to identify the open Cartier complement over Spec R with Spec K. Apply GaloisCover.exists_baseChange along t followed by kappa. Extract the square with p using IsPullback.of_right' and paste with the complement square. Its inverse isoPullback identifies the entire source pullback with this field torsor, over Spec R.

Apply field_torsor_galois_components to the field torsor. Compose the source isomorphisms and prove its R-structure equation by coproduct extensionality, Spec.map_comp and the composite R-algebra definition. Apply normalization_stalk_field_coproduct to obtain the integral-closure product model over Spec R.

For each component, compose its open coproduct inclusion with the inverse field presentation and prove its structure equation. Apply field_torsor_component_galois_group, transport the canonical automorphism action along the inverse multiplicative equivalence using MulSemiringAction.compHom, and apply IsGaloisGroup.of_mulEquiv. Choose these existential action witnesses within the proof.

A finite coproduct inclusion of spectra is finite: reindex Fin n by ULift into the ring universe, use sigmaSpec and the surjective evaluation ring map, then cancel the sigmaSpec isomorphism. Compose this inclusion with the inverse normalization model and the finite base-changed normalization projection. The structure equation identifies the composite with Spec of the factor algebraMap. IsFinite.SpecMap_iff and RingHom.finite_algebraMap give Module.Finite for each factor. No factor is selected when n=0.

lean.statement:
theorem cartier_stalk_normalization_product
    {N U P : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian N]
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G] (W : GaloisCover G U)
    (V : N.Opens) (κ : V.toScheme ⟶ U) (p : P ⟶ V.toScheme) [IsFinite p]
    (r : P ⟶ W.P) (hpb : IsPullback r p W.π κ) :
    let a := p ≫ V.ι
    Etale p → IsFinite a.fromNormalization →
    ∀ (D : Scheme.{u}) (j : D ⟶ N),
      IsIntegral D → IsEffectiveCartierCenter j →
      (∀ z : N, z ∈ V ↔ z ∉ Set.range j) →
      ∀ (η : D), IsGenericPoint η Set.univ →
      ∀ (hdom : IsDomain (N.presheaf.stalk (j η))),
      letI := hdom
      IsDiscreteValuationRing (N.presheaf.stalk (j η)) →
      let R := N.presheaf.stalk (j η)
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (E : Fin n → Type u) (hE : ∀ i, Field (E i))
        (aE : ∀ i, Algebra (FractionRing R) (E i)),
        letI := hE
        letI := aE
        letI (i : Fin n) : Algebra R (E i) :=
          ((algebraMap (FractionRing R) (E i)).comp
            (algebraMap R (FractionRing R))).toAlgebra
        ∃ (T : Fin n → Subgroup G) (act : ∀ i, MulSemiringAction (T i) (E i)),
          letI := act
          (∀ i, IsGaloisGroup (T i) (FractionRing R) (E i)) ∧
          (∀ i, Module.Finite R (integralClosure R (E i))) ∧
          ∃ e : pullback a.fromNormalization (N.fromSpecStalk (j η)) ≅
              ∐ fun i : Fin n ↦ Spec (CommRingCat.of (integralClosure R (E i))),
            e.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun i : Fin n ↦
              Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (integralClosure R (E i))))) =
              pullback.snd a.fromNormalization (N.fromSpecStalk (j η))
